content: Action Required: Upcoming Changes to the Email Template Builder We want to make you aware of an important update regarding our integration with Beefree. Beefree is transitioning away from its legacy authentication system, and this change will affect the Email Template Builder unless action is taken. Please review the attached letter to see the steps you need to take. On this page, you will learn how to create and send our "out of the box" {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}} s via flows! If our "out of the box" {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}} doesn't meet your requirements, head over to our Email Template Builder documentation to check out how to create your own templates! Salesforce Configurations There are several standard configuration steps that will improve the deliverability and professionalism of emails sent from Salesforce. These configuration steps will impact all emails generated from within Salesforce, not just Blackthorn. Please work with your Salesforce administrator to complete the following steps. Enable email security compliance and include Salesforce in your SPF record: Sender Policy Framework Create a DKIM key: Set Up Secure DKIM Keys In-Person Event Emails After an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} registers for an in-person {{variable.Object_Event}} , they need to get a confirmation email that includes their {{variable.AttendeeLink}} . The {{variable.AttendeeLink}} is where they will access their QR code and information about the {{variable.Object_Event}} , so it’s important that this stands out. This section will walk through creating a process that sends out an in-person {{variable.Object_Event}} email alert. Setup Guide Complete the following steps to set up the Email feature. Prerequisite Invoices and confirmation emails must be sent to more than the primary contact. Activate the Flows Go to Setup. In the Quick Find box, enter and click "Flows." Click View Details and Versions in the drop-down navigation next to the Flow you need to activate. Click Activate . When you go back to the list of Flows, you will see a checkmark next to the Flow you just activated. We recommend activating the following Flows: Send Blackthorn | Event confirmation email (Send_Blackthorn_Event_confirmation_email) Send Blackthorn | Event invite email (Send_Blackthorn_Event_invite_email) Send Blackthorn | Event Reminder email (Send_Blackthorn_Event_Reminder_email) Send Cancelled Registration Email (Send_Cancelled_Registration_Email) Send the Waitlisted Email (Send_the_Waitlisted_Email) Send the removed from the Waitlist Email (Send_the_removed_from_the_Waitlist_Email) Note: The workflows of the same name were recently converted to flows. Add Email Addresses Click the {{variable.Button_GearIcon}} . Click {{variable.Button_Setup}} . In the Quick Find box, enter and click "Organization-Wide Addresses".  Click Add .  Fill in the following fields.  Display Name (required) Email Address (required) Select a Purpose Check either “Allow All Profiles to Use this From Address” or “Allow Only Selected Profiles to Use the From Address”.  Select one or more Profiles.  Click {{variable.Button_Save}} .  Open the email program for the email address that was entered. Click the link to verify the email address.  The organization-wide email address’s Status will now be “Verified.” Create the Out-of-the-Box Email Templates Go to the Blackthorn | Events Admin tab. Click the {{variable.Button_CreateEmailTemplates}} button on the Configuration tab. Review the Templates section to learn more about the available Email Templates. Templates Invite Email We provide a basic HTML {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}} with a Flow from the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} object to get you started. Invites are sent when an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} 's {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_RegistrStatus}} = {{variable.Picklist_AttendeeReg_Invited}} . Your invited {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s will receive a custom experience through our {{variable.AttendeeLink}} feature, including a personal welcome message, preselected ticket type, RSVP option, and more! In addition to your customers receiving an amazing experience, you will receive information about {{variable.Object_Event}} invite open rates, if the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} has declined your RSVP, and the ability to check-in {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s through a QR code! Confirmation Email You can customize the registration confirmation email your {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s receive when they register for your {{variable.Object_Event}} . We provide a basic HTML {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}} with a Flow from the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} object that can be cloned and updated for specific {{variable.Object_Event}} s. Confirmation is sent when an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} 's {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_RegistrStatus}} = {{variable.Picklist_AttendeeReg_Registere}} . Sending Reminders After you make your {{variable.Object_Event}} live, you can customize the reminder email you send to {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s that were invited previously. We provide a basic HTML {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}} with a Flow from the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} object to get you started. Send to Multiple {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s Reminders are sent when an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} 's {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_SendReminder}} = {{variable.Checkbox_True}} . You can also send reminders from the {{variable.Object_Event}} record to all invited {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s: Navigate to Setup. Go to the {{variable.Object_Event}} s Object. Click Page Layouts. Click the "Event Layout" link. Click Buttons in the Event Layout menu. Add the {{variable.Button_SendReminder}} button to the layout. Clicking the {{variable.Button_SendReminder}} button will select and send an email to all the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s with a {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_RegistrStatus}} = {{variable.Picklist_AttendeeReg_Invited}} . Send to a Specific {{variable.Object_Attendee}} Navigate to Setup Go to {{variable.Object_Attendee}} Object. Click Page Layouts. Click the "Attendee Layout" link. In the "Fields" section, add the {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_SendReminder}} checkbox. Go to the specific {{variable.Object_Attendee}} record. Check the {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_SendReminder}} checkbox. Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Waitlist Emails Once an {{variable.Object_Event}} reaches capacity, you can send a waitlisting email. This will let the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} know the {{variable.Object_Event}} is at capacity, but if a slot becomes available, they'll be invited to the {{variable.Object_Event}} via email. We provided a basic HTML {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}} with a Flow from the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} object to get you started. Added to Waitlist Email This email will let the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} know they have been added to the {{variable.Object_Waitlist}} for the {{variable.Object_Event}} . The {{variable.Object_Waitlist}} notification is sent when an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} 's {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_RegistrStatus}} = {{variable.Picklist_AttendeeReg_WaitPendi}} . Removed from Waitlist Email This email will let the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} know they have been removed from the {{variable.Object_Waitlist}} for the {{variable.Object_Event}} . The {{variable.Object_Attendee}} will then receive an invite email. The waitlist notification is sent when an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} 's {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_RegistrStatus}} = {{variable.Picklist_AttendeeReg_Pending}} . QR Code If you do not see the QR code in the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} 's confirmation email, use one of the following methods to add it. Use a dynamic image to add a QR code. Open an existing {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}} or create a new one. Determine where you want to place the QR code.  Drag and drop the Image icon in the Content navigation to the spot where you want to add the QR code. Toggle on the Dynamic image. Place the merge tag “Attendee -> QR Code” in any other text block.  Cut the merge tag and paste it into the Image’s Dynamic URL field. Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . The QR code will now be visible at the bottom of the email. Update the confirmation {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}} with the HTML code below. Your browser does not support PDF.click here to download Payment Emails Payment Receipt Email A payment receipt is sent when the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} 's {{variable.Field_PTInvoice_PaymentStatus}} = {{variable.Picklist_Invoice_Paid}} and the {{variable.Field_PTInvoice_RecordType}} = {{variable.Picklist_Invoice_Invoice}} and if the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} is created from an {{variable.Object_Event}} registration. Payment Request Email A payment request notification is sent when the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} 's {{variable.Field_PTInvoice_PaymentStatus}} = {{variable.Picklist_Invoice_Unpaid}} and the {{variable.Field_PTInvoice_RecordType}} = {{variable.Picklist_Invoice_Invoice}} and if the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} is created from an {{variable.Object_Event}} registration. Basic Workflow and Event Receipt Email Template A payment received notification is sent when an {{variable.Object_Invoice}} 's {{variable.Field_PTInvoice_PaymentStatus}} = {{variable.Picklist_Invoice_Paid}} and the {{variable.Field_PTInvoice_RecordType}} = {{variable.Picklist_Invoice_Invoice}} and if the {{variable.Object_Invoice}} is created from an {{variable.Object_Event}} registration. This workflow and {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}} can be enabled when you are ready to use it. Navigate to Setup. Type in and select "Workflow Rules". Click the related workflow rule. Activate the workflow to start using the rule and email. Webinar Emails Overview After an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} registers for a webinar, they need to receive a confirmation email that includes their {{variable.AttendeeLink}} . The {{variable.AttendeeLink}} is where they will access the webinar, so it’s important that this stands out. This section will walk through the process of creating a webinar email alert. Setup Guide In Setup, search for "Classic Email Templates". Click the "New Template" option and select "Custom (without using Classic Letterhead)". Name your {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}} ; for this example, we've used "Blackthorn | Events Webinar Confirmation Email". Mark "Available for Use". Enter a subject line. We've used "Confirmation for {!conference360__Attendee__c.conference360__Event_Name__c}" as our subject line, feel free to change it up! Copy the HTML code into the body. You can use the HTML codes below as a template to get started. (Optional) Give it a test by clicking Send Test and Verify Merge Fields. Define a {{variable.Object_Contact}} and {{variable.Object_Attendee}} record. Send it to your email. Setup an {{variable.Workflow_EmailAlerts}} to send from our {{variable.ProcessBuilder}} . Click Setup. Search for "Email Alerts" in the Quick Find box. Click {{variable.Button_NewEmailAlert}} . Define the following fields: {{variable.Field_EmailAlerts_Description}} : add a friendly name for your {{variable.Workflow_EmailAlerts}} {{variable.Field_EmailAlerts_Object}} : choose the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} {{variable.Field_EmailAlerts_EmailTemplat}} : choose the {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}} used in the previous steps {{variable.Field_EmailAlerts_FrmEmailAddr}} = select the Current User's Email Address (This is the user who authorized Blackthorn Events to send emails.) Create a new process in the {{variable.ProcessBuilder}} . Choose the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} object. Select {{variable.Field_ProcessBuild_recordcreat}} . Define criteria for action group when conditions are met: Set the {{variable.Field_ProcessBuild_EventCatego}} (conference360__Category__c) to "Virtual Event". This step only defines the category for Virtual Events. If you need a process to send in-person Event emails, set up a new process for that. Immediate action: Send (custom) Email Alert for Virtual Event confirmation. Your {{variable.ProcessBuilder}} should now appear similar to the following image: Click the Activate button in the top right corner, and you're done! Now when {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s register for the webinar, they will receive a confirmation email with the webinar details and a link to join the meeting. Templates Below is a list of {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}} s we have built for you. Webinar Confirmation HTML #1 Email #1 received when an {{variable.ObjectAttendee}} registers for an {{variable.ObjectEvent}}. The Webinar begins on {!conference360__Attendee__c.conference360__Event_Start_Date__c} at {!conference360__Attendee__c.conference360__Event_Start_Time__c}. {!conference360__Attendee__c.conference360__Event_Description__c} Webinar "Sorry We Missed You" To be sent if an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} doesn't show up to the webinar. Hi, {!conference360__Attendee__c.conference360__First_Name__c} We noticed you weren't able to make it to {!conference360__Attendee__c.conference360__Event_Name__c}. We're bummed we missed you, but we've got you covered! An on-demand webinar can be viewed here at your convenience: WATCH THE REPLAY <LINK> Thank you, Blackthorn Email Configuration Are you trying to configure which {{variable.Object_Attendee}} {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_RegistrStatus}} should receive certain emails? Well, you've come to the right place. Normally this is only possible through Salesforce workflows, but we've added some flexibility to that. This is configurable on each individual {{variable.Object_Event}} record, and templates can be pulled from the Email Template Builder. The BT Event Email Config was added with the standard {{variable.PS_ET_Organizer}} in mind. The component comes with three lookup fields for organizers to search and apply which {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}} s fire with the appropriate {{variable.Object_Attendee}} status. When an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} 's {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_RegistrStatus}} = {{variable.Picklist_AttendeeReg_Registere}} , the confirmation email will send. When an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} 's {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_RegistrStatus}} = {{variable.Picklist_AttendeeReg_WaitPendi}} , the waitlisted email will send. When an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} 's {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_RegistrStatus}} = {{variable.Picklist_AttendeeReg_Pending}} , the waitlisted-pending email will send. The {{variable.Field_EmailConfig_SendEmailFro}} dropdown field in the {{variable.Component_EmailConfiguration}} component lists verified organization-wide email addresses. The picklist options include the current user, the user who authenticated the Events app, and the “Created By User” or the user who created the {{variable.Object_Event}} . Please note that for an email address to be available in the {{variable.Field_EmailConfig_SendEmailFro}} field in the email component, the email address must be set as an organization-wide email address. Setting the {{variable.Field_EmailConfig_SendEmailFro}} field in the {{variable.Component_EmailConfiguration}} component to the current user does not change the email sender for after-registration emails sent to {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s who registered via a webpage. Those emails are sent from the user who authorized the Events app because the checkout process runs in the authorized user's name. If a logged-in user creates {{variable.Object_Attendee}} records manually from the backend or the Attendee Registration Component, all emails will be sent from that user's email because they created the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} records. However, when {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s register via the {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s webpage, the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} records are created in the name of the Blackthorn authenticated user. Working with Merge Fields If an {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}} uses merge fields mapped from custom questions on the registration form, recipients will receive emails with blank values. This occurs because custom questions take up to two minutes to process and map, and since the Email component does not have a delay feature, the email is sent instantly upon the creation of the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} record. To prevent this, use delayed custom automation to send emails. Helpful Tips Why don't I see the image in the email? If you don't see an image in the email, use the steps below to troubleshoot the problem. Image URL Check the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_ImageURL}} to make sure the URL is not broken and starts with “http://” or “https://”. Using Images Stored in Documents If you are using Documents to store the image, complete the following steps. Add an image to the Documents tab. On the Documents home page, open the image by clicking its name. Right-click the image and get its reusable URL address. When you use the URL, you reference the copy of the image on the Salesforce server. Paste the URL in the {{variable.Object_Event}} {{variable.Field_ETEvent_ImageURL}} field. Images Uploaded via Files The {{variable.Object_Attendee}} object includes a formula field that captures the {{variable.Object_Event}} 's image. This field displays the image in the invite, confirmation, and reminder emails. Unfortunately, Classic Email Templates do not support images uploaded through Files. To ensure the image is visible, upload the {{variable.Object_Event}} image to Documents or customize the {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}} and remove the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} {{variable.Field_Attendee_EventImageURL}} (conference360__Event_Image_URL__c) field reference. How do I attach a file to my Email Template? Go to Setup. In the Quick Find box, enter and click “Classic Email Templates.” Go to the Blackthorn | Events or Blackthorn | Payments folder. Click the name of the {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}} you need to access. (All {{variable.Object_EmailTemplate}} s created in the Email Template Builder are stored as Classic Email Templates too.) Scroll down to the Attachments section at the bottom of the page. Click Attach File . Select the file you want to attach. The attached file is now visible at the bottom of your Email Template. For more information about files and Salesforce, see the Using Salesforce Files article.
